{"python": "CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": {
        "unit": {"value": "patient_regimen", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "Units are 54 LCOs (patient-regimen instances) from 36 patients, each with matched clinical and LCO-DST results"},
        "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": ["article:p6"], "explanation": "Assay uses lung cancer organoids (LCOs)"},
        "readout": {"value": "viability", "evidence": ["article:p128"], "explanation": "LCO sensitivity is measured as ratio of treated/untreated ATP luminance (viability)"},
        "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["article:p128"], "explanation": "Lower viability ratio indicates higher LCO sensitivity to treatment"},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "roc_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p128"], "explanation": "Cutoff was determined via ROC analysis to discriminate clinical response"},
        "threshold_timing": {"value": "outcome_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "ROC optimization used the same 54-unit evaluation cohort"},
        "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["article:p35", "supp.pdf/page4"], "explanation": "Individual LCO-DST and clinical response are linked for each unit"},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "Clinical regimens were identical to LCO-DST test regimens for all included units"},
        "n_units": {"value": 54, "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p101", "supp.pdf/page4"], "explanation": "Total of 54 LCOs included in the accuracy analysis: 21+5+4+24 = 54"},
        "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p102"], "explanation": "Analysis performed on a single real-world cohort, no independent test split"}
    },
    "headline": {
        "metric": "accuracy",
        "reported": 0.8333333333333334,
        "reported_evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p101", "supp.pdf/page4/R3C3"],
        "threshold": None,
        "op": None,
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": [
            # Correct predictions: 21 (TP) + 24 (TN) = 45
            *[{"id": f"TP_{i}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R5C2", "map": {"21": 1}}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R4C1", "map": {"PR": 1}}} for i in range(21)],
            *[{"id": f"TN_{i}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R7C3", "map": {"24": 0}}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R4C2", "map": {"PD": 0}}} for i in range(24)],
            # Incorrect predictions: 5 (FP) + 4 (FN) = 9
            *[{"id": f"FP_{i}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R5C3", "map": {"5": 1}}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R4C2", "map": {"PD": 0}}} for i in range(5)],
            *[{"id": f"FN_{i}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R7C2", "map": {"4": 0}}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R4C1", "map": {"PR": 1}}} for i in range(4)]
        ],
        "blocked_reason": ""
    },
    "notes": ["Accuracy calculation: (21 + 24) / 54 = 45 / 54 = 0.8333333333333334, matching the reported value.", "Confusion matrix: TP=21, FN=4, FP=5, TN=24 per supp.pdf page 4."]
}

# Verify the accuracy calculation
correct = 21 + 24
total = 21 + 5 + 4 + 24
accuracy = correct / total
print(f"Calculated accuracy: {accuracy}, matches target: {abs(accuracy - 0.8333333333333334) < 0.0005}, total units: {total}")
"}
